title: RunRecord
description: Complete record of a single agent run, including all proposed actions, policy decisions, authority records, reliance records, and blocked actions.

task.description: Top-level task description for the run.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the run was started.

frame.description: Execution frame active for this run.

actions.description: All action proposals made during the run.

decisions.description: All policy decisions made during the run.

policy_traces.description: Policy evaluation traces produced during the run.

authority_records.description: Authority records active during the run.

reliance_records.description: External-source reliance records from the run.

blocked_actions.description: Actions that were blocked during the run.

completed.description: Whether the run has been marked as completed.

final_output.description: Final output produced by the agent at the end of the run.

replay_bundle_id.description: ID of the ReplayBundle generated for this run, if any.
